faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions

whatIsMorkBorg.a: MÖRK BORG is a doom metal album of a game. A rules-light, art-heavy tabletop RPG about lost souls seeking redemption in a bleak world. The game is published by Free League Publishing.

whatIsScvmGrinder.a: Scvm Rack is a free character sheet and generator for MÖRK BORG. It helps you create characters, track stats, and manage equipment during your games.

isItFree.a: Yes! Scvm Rack is completely free to use. You can create and save characters without paying anything.

guestVsAccount.a: No account needed to start. As a guest, you get one character — generating a new one replaces it. Characters are kept for 7 days. Sign up (free) to keep unlimited characters permanently, accessible from any device.

howToSave.q: How do I save my character?
howToSave.a: Characters save automatically as you edit. As a guest, your single character is stored for 7 days. Sign up to keep it permanently and create more.

multipleCharacters.a: With an account, yes — create and switch between as many characters as you like from the Scvms menu. As a guest, you get exactly one. Generating a new scvm replaces the current one.

mobileSupport.a: Yes! Scvm Rack is designed to work on phones, tablets, and desktops. Use it at the table or on the go.

offlineUse.a: Currently, Scvm Rack requires an internet connection. Offline support may be added in the future.

knownIssues.a: A couple of inventory quirks we're still polishing: identical items stack together to keep things tidy, but editing one item in a stack while also changing its quantity can occasionally apply the edit to the wrong copy. Workaround: edit the item first, then change the quantity separately. A cleaner fix that keeps stacked items as individuals is on the way.

bugReport.q: I found a bug! How do I report it?
bugReport.a: Found something broken? Open a bug report here with what happened, or use GitHub issues if you prefer a public trail. Every report helps keep Scvm Rack sturdy.

howCanIHelp.a: You can support the project on Buy Me a Coffee: https://ko-fi.com/tackgnols_rpgtools. Every contribution helps keeping the rack alive!

privacy.title: BLOOD OATH
privacy.subtitle: Data, Tracking, and Storage Notice

sections.storage: Browser storage is required for core operation. We store technical and gameplay data on your device, including language settings, session flags, active character references, and privacy preferences.
sections.backend: Character and gameplay content that you enter in this app is transmitted to and stored on our backend services, including guest sessions. This storage occurs even if you do not create an account.
sections.analytics: If analytics is enabled below, Google Analytics is used to process usage events and page activity. You can disable analytics at any time without losing core app functionality.
sections.sensitiveData: Do not enter sensitive personal data in character fields. By continuing to use this app, you acknowledge and accept this notice.

release.title: Release Notes
release.moreUpdates: More updates coming soon. The world is ending, but we keep shipping.

v061.gettingBetter: MÖRK BORG's Getting Better advancement has landed — preview the roll, reroll if you don't like it, then apply it to level up
v061.scumFixes: Scum improvement abilities and specialty descriptions now read correctly instead of overlapping or falling back to English
v061.obrOpen: Anonymous Owlbear characters can now open in the full Scvmrack site in one click
v061.identityCarry: The new tab carries the same session without moving character ownership away from Owlbear
v061.safeRetry: Blocked tabs and expired handoff links now show a clear retry prompt
v061.obrOwnership: Owlbear ownership handling is more reliable after bumping the shared rpgtools-owlbear package to 0.1.1

v060.miseries: Character sheets now include the seven-step Misery track, with controls for players and GMs
v060.recovery: Missing, forbidden, and session-transition routes now recover cleanly without deleting character data or getting stuck
v060.monitoring: GlitchTip now filters expected browser and API noise while preserving actionable release and source-map diagnostics
v060.owlbear: Owlbear room visibility, enemy cards, token binding, and session handling are more reliable

v057.obrVisibility: Owlbear room character visibility is now consistent across roster, enemy cards, and room APIs
v057.obrTransport: The Owlbear panel now uses the app OpenAPI transport for consistent CSRF and session handling
v057.obrManifestVersion: The OBR manifest now reports version 0.5.7

v056.sharedOwlbearPackage: The Owlbear panel now runs on a shared, reusable package used across RPGTools apps — no behavior change for players

v055.sharedAuthHandoff: The Owlbear Rodeo popup sign-in now runs on the shared RPGTools auth stack, the same audited flow used across all RPGTools apps
v055.internalCleanup: Removed a leftover internal table that is no longer needed

v054.obrEnemyTokenPopover: Player enemy cards now open from bound enemy token popovers instead of the character sheet
v054.obrEnemySafeProjection: Player enemy popovers use the safe enemy-card projection while GM popovers keep the full editable form
v054.obrManifestVersion: The OBR manifest now reports version 0.5.4

v053.obrEnemyAutoSetup: The Owlbear Rodeo GM enemy tab now prepares its room enemy board automatically
v053.obrEnemyNoLoginGate: GMs can add enemies from Owlbear without a scvmrack login or manual party promotion step
v053.obrManifestVersion: The OBR manifest now reports version 0.5.3

v052.obrManifestVersion: The OBR manifest now reports version 0.5.2
v052.obrPopoverCacheBust: Owlbear Rodeo reloads the current extension entrypoint for player names, Forge/Login actions, and room enemy management
v052.obrNoStore: The public OBR manifest and popover shell now send no-store cache headers

v051.obrManifestCors: Owlbear Rodeo can install the Scvmrack manifest because the public extension files now send CORS headers

v050.tokenBinding: Players can bind or re-bind selected tokens, and bound selections show the scvm name
v050.cardPeek: Bound tokens expose a compact View scvm card with HP, Omens, silver, combat targets, armor DR, gear, traits, and modifiers

v050.drFiltering: Party and Owlbear warband rows now show armor DR and use the same modifier filtering as the main sheet

v044.structuredLogging: Unexpected backend errors now log full stack traces through the shared service error helper
v044.sseCleanup: Party live-update streams now close half-open sockets when a write fails before the client disconnects
v044.repositoryLayering: Catalog reads now go through repositories instead of direct database calls from library code

v043.partyNameContrast: Party-name text on the GM overview now stays black on yellow so it remains readable while creating a party
v043.partyNameLimit: Party creation now checks party names in the browser and blocks submit above 100 characters
v043.localizedFeedback: The party-name validation message is localized in English and Polish

v042.lanternConsumable: Lanterns and torches show up in the Consumables section with their use pips and count toward encumbrance again, instead of being treated as ammunition

v041.itemSearch: Equipment search now returns Polish item names on the Polish view instead of English ones
v041.dates: The character list now formats dates in the active language

owlbear.title: Owlbear Rodeo
owlbear.intro: Scvmrack runs inside Owlbear Rodeo as a room extension. Players keep their sheet open next to the map. Game masters get a live roster of every scvm at the table, without a second browser tab.

install.heading: Install
install.step1: Open your Owlbear Rodeo room and go to Settings → Manage Extensions.
install.step2: Paste this manifest URL and confirm:
install.step3: Scvmrack appears in the room's action bar. Click it to open the sheet.
install.screenshot: Owlbear Rodeo's 'Add a custom extension' dialog with the Scvmrack manifest URL pasted into the Install Link field

sheet.title: Your sheet, in the room
sheet.text: Open the Scvmrack action to see your scvm exactly as it is on the main site: stats, inventory, HP, Omens. Edit it without leaving Owlbear.
sheet.screenshot: The Scvmrack popover open in an Owlbear Rodeo room, showing a player's editable character sheet next to the map

bind.title: Bind your token
bind.text: Select your token on the map and bind it to your scvm. The token's name label updates to show who it is, and you can re-bind it any time you switch scvms or tokens.
bind.screenshot: The Scvmrack panel after selecting a token on the map, with the 'Bind to selected token' button ready

peek.title: Peek any bound token
peek.text: Right-click a bound token for a compact card: HP, Omens, silver, combat targets, armor, gear, traits, and active modifiers. No need to open the full sheet.
peek.screenshot: A token's right-click menu with 'View scvm' selected, opening its compact card

roster.title: The room roster, live
roster.text: Every bound token shows up in your roster tab. HP, stats, and who is connected update as players play, with no refresh needed.
roster.screenshot: The GM roster listing bound characters with live HP and ability scores

promote.title: Promote the room to a party
promote.text: Sign in and turn the room into a durable Scvmrack party. You get a manage link for yourself and an invite link for new players, and both keep working after the Owlbear session ends.
promote.screenshot: The GM roster with its generated invite link, after promoting the room to a Scvmrack party

enemies.title: Run the enemy board
enemies.text: Add enemies from inside Owlbear and drop them onto tokens on the map. Players who click a bound enemy token see a read-only card; you keep the full editable version.
enemies.screenshot: The GM Enemies tab with a table threat, showing HP, morale, armor, and loot notes
